tag.zh: 廣深港高鐵香港段路軌與接觸網維護M1156
tag.en: Hong Kong High-Speed Rail Maintenance M1156-17C Project

title.en: Hong Kong High-Speed Rail Maintenance M1156-17C Project

summary.zh: 本項目為電氣化局與中鐵一局聯合體於2018年3月14日獲得中標通知書，業主為香港鐵路有限公司，合約主要範圍為廣深港高鐵香港段路軌與接觸網維護。包含正線26公里的接觸網及172個人防門。
summary.en: This project was awarded by the Electrification Bureau and China Railway First Bureau consortium on March 14, 2018. The owner is MTR Corporation Limited, and the contract mainly covers the maintenance of tracks and overhead wires on the Hong Kong section of the Guangzhou-Shenzhen-Hong Kong High-Speed Rail. This includes 26 kilometers of main line overhead and 172 personal security gates.

blocks.zh:
一、項目建設基本概況
（一）工程概況
本項目為電氣化局與中鐵一局聯合體於2018年3月14日獲得中標通知書，業主為香港鐵路有限公司，合約主要範圍為廣深港高鐵香港段路軌與接觸網維護。包含正線26公里的接觸網及172個人防門。
（二）合同價款及各專業本月施工產值完成情況
合同金額為5860萬港幣。專案於2021年9月，與業主續期三年。
本月產值完成情況:
接觸網專業：109萬人民幣（匯率0.82）
開累完成工作量6357萬港幣。
（三）工期目標
開工日期2018年4月1日，合同計畫竣工日期2021年9月30日。續期合同工期為2021年9月-2024年9月，共36個月。
blocks.en:
1. Basic Overview of Project Construction
(1) Project Overview
This project was awarded by the Electrification Bureau and China Railway First Bureau consortium on March 14, 2018. The owner is MTR Corporation Limited, and the contract mainly covers the maintenance of tracks and overhead wires on the Hong Kong section of the Guangzhou-Shenzhen-Hong Kong High-Speed Rail. This includes 26 kilometers of main line overhead and 172 personal security gates. 
(2) Contract price and the completion status of construction output for each specialty this month
The contract amount is HKD 58.6 million. The project was renewed for three years with the owner in September 2021. 
This month's output completion status: 
Contact Network Major: 1.09 million RMB (exchange rate 0.82)
The total work completed was 63.57 million HKD. 
Construction Schedule Targets
Construction start date is April 1, 2018, and the contract completion date is planned for September 30, 2021. The renewal contract period is from September 2021 to September 2024, totaling 36 months. 
2. Project progress and overall construction node planning arrangements
1. Catenary specialty
Construction Progress: 
This month, the overhead contact patrols mainly focused on defect measurement, overhead inspection on foot, and static measurements of the overhead wires in the inspection data and reports of the Guangzhou-Shenzhen MTR (Hong Kong section); Engineering vehicles made 15 trips, focusing on section insulator inspection, switch inspection, joint inspection, electrical connection inspection, and problem database problem-solving. Six overhead inspections were conducted, and four walks were carried out on foot for tunnel connection door CPD equipment. 
On-site installation and commissioning of Shigang 5C equipment have been completed. All 5C data is now available on the website, with no data integrity. You can log in to check the results. From the debugging results, due to the installation position being somewhat at the center of the track track, the imaging quality was not ideal. Minor adjustments are needed later. We have completed the adjustment plan, mainly including profile tilt, individual camera connection issues, radar speed measurement module optimization, and on-site network problems. On May 9, 2022, we assisted the manufacturer with adjustments. On-site installation and commissioning of West Kowloon 6C equipment are complete. Pending subsequent signal reception and debugging, 3C equipment installation is finished. The onboard equipment of 0256 is running normally. We perform weekly maintenance. Server terminal issues require the manufacturer to come to Hong Kong to resolve them. All temporary monitoring is done by replacing hard drives to view video contacts. 4C equipment has been assisted by the manufacturer and is installing 4C equipment on the EAW01X vehicle. The control room equipment for 3C and 4C West Kowloon stations has arrived in Hong Kong. The equipment for 2C-6C station buildings needs to be addressed. MTR has already provided station buildings, and servers and other equipment have been moved into the rooms, and are waiting for domestic manufacturers to come to Hong Kong to install equipment. 
Currently, three more tunnel leaks affecting the overhead wire have been found, and six tunnels affecting CPD equipment are being communicated with the MTR to repair the leaks as soon as possible. For all locations where water is no longer leaking, we will carry out cleaning of the contact networks, mainly focusing on the bearing cables and contact wires. Whether the contact cables are affected will continue to communicate with the MTR maintenance team. 

3. Main Problems, Causes, and Countermeasures During Construction
The main issues currently found; None
4. Labor and machinery allocation and demand plans
Currently, there are 5 management staff and 28 construction workers on duty; 
Currently 4 command and work-delivery vehicles; 1 emergency rescue passenger/cargo van (purchased on 2018.8.18); 1 constant tension catapult (CDW) (provided by MTR); 2 overhead operation vehicles OIV (provided by MTR); 1 flatbed truck (provided by MTR). 
No demand plans yet.

title.zh: 港鐵「三綫」供電系統改造

summary.zh: 荃灣綫、觀塘綫、港島綫供電系統更新改造，覆蓋 49 公里、39 個車站，合約額 30.32 億港元，為港鐵史上最大規模供電改造工程。
summary.en: Power supply renewal across the Tsuen Wan, Kwun Tong and Island lines — 49 km, 39 stations, HKD 3.032 billion, the largest power supply overhaul in MTR history.

blocks.zh: 由集團牽頭的聯營體中標香港地鐵荃灣綫、觀塘綫、港島綫供電系統改造項目，合約額 30.32 億港元。三條線路為香港首期建成、營運近 40 年的市區骨幹線路，日運輸量約佔港鐵日均 500 萬人次的一半。改造涉及 49 公里、39 個車站，內容涵蓋高低壓供電系統更新改造的設計、供貨、安裝與測試。由於線路每天營運超過 19 小時，改造難度、工期與任務之艱巨堪稱港鐵之最。
blocks.en: A joint venture led by the Group was awarded the power supply system renewal of the MTR Tsuen Wan, Kwun Tong and Island lines, valued at HKD 3.032 billion. These three lines — Hong Kong's first metro lines, in service for nearly 40 years — carry about half of the MTR's 5 million daily passenger trips. Spanning 49 km and 39 stations, the works cover the design, supply, installation and testing of high- and low-voltage power systems. With lines operating over 19 hours a day, the difficulty, duration and complexity of the renewal are unprecedented in MTR history.

summary.zh: 東涌綫延綫、屯門南延綫及東鐵綫共 7 個車站月台幕門的設計、供貨、安裝與調試，集團首個 NEC 合約模式項目。
summary.en: Design, supply, installation and commissioning of platform screen doors at 7 stations on the Tung Chung Line Extension, Tuen Mun South Extension and East Rail Line — the Group's first NEC-contract project.

blocks.zh: 以聯營體名義中標香港鐵路有限公司東涌延綫、屯門延綫及東鐵綫月台幕門設計、供貨、安裝、調試項目，工程範圍覆蓋東涌西、東涌東、小濠灣、屯門南、屯門 16 區、洪水橋及古洞共 7 個車站的月台幕門及自動月台閘門，並負責與其他機電系統及土木承辦商的接口設計與工期協調。本項目為集團首次中標香港地鐵月台幕門專業項目，也是首個 NEC 合約模式項目。
blocks.en: Through a joint venture, the Group was awarded the design, supply, installation and commissioning of platform screen doors for the Tung Chung Line Extension, Tuen Mun South Extension and East Rail Line — covering seven stations: Tung Chung West, Tung Chung East, Siu Ho Wan, Tuen Mun South, Tuen Mun Area 16, Hung Shui Kiu and Kwu Tung — including interface design and programme coordination with other E&M and civil contractors. This is the Group's first MTR platform screen door contract and its first project under the NEC contract model.

summary.zh: 京津城際、京滬高鐵、哈大高鐵、蘭新高鐵……集團在中國高鐵建設史上創造多項中國第一與世界第一。
summary.en: Beijing–Tianjin Intercity, Beijing–Shanghai HSR, Harbin–Dalian HSR, Lanzhou–Xinjiang HSR — multiple national and world firsts in high-speed rail construction.

blocks.zh:
京津城際高鐵——中國第一條時速 350 公里高速鐵路

京滬高鐵——世界最高水平高速鐵路

哈大高鐵——世界首條高寒地區高速鐵路

蘭新高鐵——世界首條穿越高原和風區的高速鐵路

坦贊鐵路——中國首條援外跨國鐵路
blocks.en:
Beijing–Tianjin Intercity — China's first 350 km/h high-speed railway

Beijing–Shanghai HSR — a world benchmark for high-speed rail

Harbin–Dalian HSR — the world's first high-speed railway in severe cold regions

Lanzhou–Xinjiang HSR — the world's first HSR crossing plateaus and wind zones

TAZARA Railway — China's first international aid railway

blocks.zh: 此外，集團先後在伊朗、烏茲別克斯坦、白俄羅斯、以色列、斯里蘭卡、巴基斯坦、印度尼西亞等國家和地區承建二十多項鐵路及城市軌道交通工程，形成以中東、中亞、東南亞和中東歐四大區域市場為依託的海外格局。
blocks.en: The Group has also delivered more than twenty railway and urban rail transit projects in Iran, Uzbekistan, Belarus, Israel, Sri Lanka, Pakistan, Indonesia and beyond, building an overseas presence anchored in the Middle East, Central Asia, Southeast Asia and Central & Eastern Europe.
